description: Employment by sex and occupation, annual, thousands; sex = total. High-income benchmark countries for the composition counterfactual (plan review3, step 6 / decision D3), fetched by the same route as ilostat/provenance.json's African files but written to a separate directory so ilostat/raw/ and macro_ilostat_v2.py's results stay byte-identical.
note: Three countries fetched (GBR, DEU, FRA), all pass the ISCO-08 coverage check (all nine major groups present, no ISCO-88-only fallback needed) and all carry a low not-classified share: GBR 0.10%, DEU 0.51%, FRA 1.02% (all far under the 20% robustness cut macro_ilostat_v2.py uses). Latest year for all three is 2025. Headline benchmark: GBR (lowest x_pct, largest LFS). DEU and FRA reported as the range.
